paragraphs.text: A DSH plugin: browse 373 agentic video-production skills and install one into ~/.claude/skills or ~/
.dsh/skills with one click. DSH 插件：在设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 的 373 个视频制作技能，一键装进 ~/.claude/s
kills 或 ~/.dsh/skills。
# dsh-video-skills
`dsh-video-skills` is a DSH web plugin that lists the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog in one set
tings page and installs a chosen repository's skill into `~/.claude/skills` or `~/.dsh/skills` by do
wnloading its GitHub archive and copying files — no code from the installed repository is ever execu
ading its GitHub archive and copying files — no code from the installed repository is ever executed.
Chinese documentation: README.zh-CN.md
## What the plugin adds
- One page seat in the DSH settings UI (`key: video-skills`, `order: 900`): an **Install to** bar wi
th `Claude` / `DSH` checkboxes (only `DSH` is checked by default and the choice is remembered in `lo
calStorage`), an **installed only** filter, and the filter bar (kind chips, minimum stars, grade, li
cense, search) over a list of at most 100 rows with "load more". Each row links to its GitHub reposi
tory and to the skill path inside it, carries an approximate repository-size badge (`≈ 27.4 MB`, or
`—` while the size is not known yet), shows download progress as an indeterminate bar (`downloaded <
n> MB`, then `archive <n> MB / <m> files`, then `copying <n> files`) with a cancel button, ticks eve
ry installed target, and uninstalls in two clicks. Copy is bilingual — `zh-CN` default, `en-US` avai

lable — and every string lives in `locale/*.json`.
- Three model tools: `video_skill_search`, `video

_skill_install` and `video_skill_uninstall`.
- One HTTP prefix route, `/video-skills/api/v1`, that t
he page talks to. The route is served even when no tool registry is composed, and the tools are regi
stered only when one is.
## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or newer (`engines` in `package.json`).
- Any DSH composition. The entry declares `inje
ct = []` and resolves its services reactively: the tools appear whenever a `tools` service exists, a
nd the HTTP route is mounted only when `webServer` exists, so CLI and TUI sessions still get all thr

ee tools.
- Runtime dependency: `tar` (used to stream, list and extract the downloaded archive). Not
hing else is installed at runtime.

ts own `package.json`, so `"dsh-video-skills"` must also appear in that array:

Local development, from a checkout of this repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`link:` installs a symlink rather than a copy, so later edits are picked up without reinstalling. Ap
pend `"dsh-video-skills"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` if it is not listed already.
## Tools
All three tools work in any composition — CLI, TUI, or Web. Only the browse-and-install page needs t
he Web UI; without a web server the plugin simply registers the tools and mounts no HTTP route.
### `video_skill_search`
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `query` | string | — | Case-insensitive substring match over repository name and description. |
|
`kind` | string | — | Exact kind: `general`, `promo`, `explainer`, `editing`, `shorts`, `avatar`, `s

tory`, `motion`, `craft`, `music`. |
| `grade` | `safe` \| `caution` | — | Security grade recorded b

y the catalog. |
| `license` | string | — | Exact license id, matched case-insensitively. |
| `minSt

ars` | integer | — | Only entries with at least this many stars. |
| `limit` | integer | `20` | Page
size, clamped to 1–100. |
Returns `{ count, items }`: `count` is the number of matches before the page limit, `items` is the p
age sorted by stars descending. Each entry carries `repo`, `path`, `stars`, `description`, `kind`, `
grade`, `language`, `license`, `previewUrl` and `sizeBytes`. `sizeBytes` is the cached GitHub reposi
tory size in bytes — the same value `GET /catalog` serves for the same entry, because the tools and
the route share one catalog loader (`createToolCatalogLoader`). It is `null` while the cache holds n
o value for that repository yet, and the field is declared as a nullable number in the tool's output
schema (see Repository sizes).
### `video_skill_install`
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| `repo` (required) | string | — | `owner/name`; an `https://github.com/` prefix and a `.git` suffix

are stripped. |
| `path` | string | detected | Skill directory inside the repository. Omit to pick

the shallowest `SKILL.md`. |
| `name` | string | detected | Override the installed skill directory n

ame. |
| `targets` | array of `claude` \| `dsh` | `["dsh"]` | Skill roots to install into; duplicate
s` | array of `claude` \| `dsh` | `["dsh"]` | Skill roots to install into; duplicates are dropped. |
Returns the engine result — on success `{ ok: true, name, installed: [{ target, dir, files }], warni
ngs: string[] }`; on failure `{ ok: false, error, message?, dir? }` with `error` one of `bad-repo`,
`bad-targets`, `fetch-failed`, `no-skill-md`, `exists`. The tool awaits the whole engine and returns
only the final result — no job object and no intermediate progress; the page uses `POST /install` a
nd polls the job for progress.
## Security posture
- No `child_process`, no shell, no `npm`, no `git` anywhere in `src/` — the only runtime dependency

is `tar`.
- Nothing from the downloaded archive is executed. The tarball is listed and its entries a

re copied; no postinstall, no script from the repository, no build step.
- Archive entries are valid
ated: an entry that escapes the extraction root is a hard error, and both listing and extraction run

with `strict: true`.
- Files only: the engine writes the skill directory and the marker file and no
thing else. A path-traversal entry or an unusable `path` parameter is rejected rather than repaired.
- A directory this plugin did not create is never overwritten, and an uninstall removes a directory

only when its marker proves this plugin installed it.
- The page makes same-origin requests to `/vi
deo-skills/api/v1` only; preview images are loaded from `raw.githubusercontent.com`. There is no wri
te path into the catalog.
